validity.recommendation: Change CapacityUnits from mtpa to bcm/y; the capacity of 0.75 is 750 million cubic meters a year in both pages. Length is about 390 km in both pages against 392 on the sheet, so no change
validity.researcher_notes: Both the Gazprom project page and the 2024 Energy Policy article give up to 750 million cubic meters of gas a year. The sheet holds 0.75 with the unit mtpa, which is a tonnes unit and does not fit a gas pipeline. The pages say about 390 km, and the sheet has 392, which is within rounding. The Energy Policy article is built on the Gazprom text, so the two count as one origin. The article adds that the supplying fields now produce only about 420 million cubic meters a year.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The 2024 Energy Policy article describes the pipeline as built and in use, and says its supply fields are in decline. No citation reports it closed.
